rationale: The synthetic evidence indicates broad product-semantic, runtime, and architecture impact across six canonical owners and multiple source and derived paths. Deterministic propagation is also absent. This requires structured delivery rather than a compact or verified path; the result is a non-authorizing benchmark candidate only.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR is approved for measurement.
Six canonical owners indicate cross-owner scope.
Eight source paths and eight derived paths are affected.
Verified Change is ineligible because it requires exactly one canonical owner, no architecture impact, and deterministic
Compact Delivery is ineligible because completed Brownfield analysis and stored quick_task context are not supplied.
Any broader impact than the supplied facts requires fail-closed escalation.
